office_does: The sheriff is Clallam County's chief law enforcement officer, running patrol, investigations and the county jail.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Sheriff Brian King, completing his first term, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Clallam County Sheriff since 2023 and a 31-year law enforcement veteran who previously commanded patrol, investigations and the regional narcotics team; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Calls for more well-trained officers, 'not fewer,' plus stronger behavioral health systems and drug enforcement [S1][S5]
Cites jail re-entry and treatment services, body-worn cameras and a digital forensics lab from his first term [S5]
Opposed SB 5974, which would let a state commission decertify elected sheriffs; supported HB 2387 [S4]
